intro: Nature's Call is a Shadowglen quest where the dryad Tarindrella seeks to uncover why the local Gnarlpine furbolgs suddenly turned against their long-standing night elf allies. By gathering carved totems from their abandoned camps, adventurers help reveal the distressing spiritual corruption spreading through Teldrassil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.
Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.
You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, it's even worse than I thought.

These engravings tell us that the Gnarlpine began having nightmares of being wiped out by some great shadow. Before long, that fear turned to rage--and the shadow to their former elven friends. To be aware of your own mind slipping away from you...
Our only hope is that this may help us better understand what is happening on Teldrassil. Thank you for your aid, friend.
